summary: Russian forces launched a large-scale drone and missile strike across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Lviv, and Dnipro, causing infrastructure damage and casualties. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted some projectiles while others struck energy infrastructure and residential areas. President Zelenskyy reported over 10 damaged energy facilities and 550,000 households without power following the overnight attack.
key_points: Russian forces launched coordinated drone and missile strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Lviv, Dnipro, and Kharkiv, causing infrastructure damage and casualties. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77260)
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted some projectiles while others struck energy infrastructure and residential areas, leaving over 550,000 households without power. (Source: @UkraineNow/84761)
President Zelenskyy reported serious damage to Kyiv's Chernihivska metro station and the Cosmo Multimall shopping center during the overnight attack. (Source: @UkraineNow/84766)
Russian strikes hit the Dnipro city bridge with a guided aerial bomb, creating a large gap in the roadway and disrupting traffic for approximately one month. (Source: @eRadarrua/124444)
A Russian attack on a central park in Novaya Vodolaga on Kharkiv region killed an infant and two women, with at least 14 people injured including seven children. (Source: @UkraineNow/84773)
Ukrainian forces struck a Russian radar station in Bryansk region near the city of Trubchevsk, degrading enemy air defense capabilities. (Source: @UkraineNow/84768)
Russian reconnaissance aircraft conducted close approaches to Finnish satellite ICEYE-X36 used by Ukraine, raising concerns about potential hostile intentions in space. (Source: @UkraineNow/84778)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched a large-scale drone and missile strike across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Lviv, and Dnipro, causing infrastructure damage and casualties. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted some projectiles while others struck energy infrastructure and residential areas. President Zelenskyy reported over 10 damaged energy facilities and 550,000 households without power following the overnight attack.

points: Kyiv was struck by multiple Geran-5 missiles, with impacts reported at Vyshneve and the Chernihivska metro station sustaining serious damage. The Cosmo Multimall shopping center and business center 'Incom' were also hit. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77239, @UkraineNow/84766, @UkraineNow/84762)

Lviv experienced multiple Geran-5 missile strikes throughout the night, with projectiles falling in the city and surrounding areas. Local reports confirmed damage to civilian infrastructure. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77236, @mon1tor_ua/77270, @mon1tor_ua/77271, @mon1tor_ua/77272, @mon1tor_ua/77274)

Irpysh suffered significant damage with 84 civilian objects affected including 70 private homes, 4 apartment buildings, and 6 vehicles. At least 17 people were injured including 8 children. (Source: @UkraineNow/84765)

Energy infrastructure across 10 regions was damaged during the overnight attack, leaving approximately 550,000 families without electricity. Data center 'Datagroup' in Kyiv was destroyed, disrupting telecommunications services. (Source: @UkraineNow/84761, @UkraineNow/84763)

A central park in Novaya Vodolaga on Kharkiv region was struck by Russian forces during peak evening hours when many families with children were present. An infant and two women were killed, with at least 14 people injured including seven children. (Source: @UkraineNow/84773, @UkraineNow/84771)

Ukrainian forces successfully struck a Russian radar station in Bryansk region near Trubchevsk city, creating gaps in enemy radar coverage and weakening their air defense system. (Source: @UkraineNow/84768)

Russian forces conducted coordinated drone and missile strikes using Geran-5 cruise missiles and reactive drones across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Lviv, Dnipro, and Kharkiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77236, @mon1tor_ua/77238, @mon1tor_ua/77239)

Russian reconnaissance aircraft conducted close approaches to Finnish satellite ICEYE-X36 used by Ukraine, coming within 200 meters or less of the commercial satellite registered in the United States. (Source: @UkraineNow/84778)
Russian military blogger claimed that Ukraine has received substantial aid from Western partners without providing reciprocal benefits to Russia. (Source: @eRadarrua/124524, @eRadarrua/124525)
Russian forces deployed drones equipped with mesh networking systems capable of signal relay and data transmission, enhancing coordination between aerial platforms. (Source: @eRadarrua/124513)
Russian military activity online decreased by 60% following Ukrainian strikes on Russian data centers, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. (Source: @UkraineNow/84764)
Russian forces advanced near Novyi Donbas according to DeepState map updates, indicating continued offensive operations in the Donetsk region. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23911)
Reactive drone groups were detected in Dnipropetrovsk and Donetsk regions, with one group reported near Dnipro city. (Source: @eRadarrua/124431, @eRadarrua/124436)
Three reactive drone groups were launched from Donetsk region toward Dnipropetrovsk region's Pavlohrad district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77258)
Reactive drone activity was reported in Poltava region with one group heading toward Kharkiv region border. (Source: @eRadarrua/124436, @mon1tor_ua/77258)

Reactive drones were launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region's Vyshneve district, with additional groups crossing from Kyiv to Zhytomyr regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77258, @mon1tor_ua/77266)
Two reactive drone groups were detected in Chernihiv region, with one group near Sloboda and another crossing toward Kyiv region. (Source: @eRadarrua/124444, @eRadarrua/124440)
Reactive drone activity was reported in Sumy region with one group near Konotop moving westward. (Source: @kpszsu/88446)
A reactive drone was detected near Slavutych in Chernihiv region traveling at high speed of 750 km/h. (Source: @eRadarrua/124523)
Two tactical missiles 'Banderol' were launched against Mykolaiv city, with air defense systems responding to the attack. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77257)
Reactive drones were launched from Odesa region toward Vinnytsia region's Haisyn district, indicating cross-regional drone operations. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77240)
Ukrainian strike drones targeted Russian logistics facilities in occupied territories, though specific locations were not detailed in available reports. (Source: @UkraineNow/84768)
Sea-based attack drones were detected in the Black Sea approaching the border area between Odesa and Mykolaiv regions, moving northward. (Source: @kpszsu/88482, @kpszsu/88469)

Russian forces launched Geran-5 cruise missiles and reactive drones simultaneously across multiple directions including from Bryansk, Chernihiv, and Sumy regions toward various Ukrainian targets. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77258, @mon1tor_ua/77266, @mon1tor_ua/77240)
Ukrainian air defense systems intercepted multiple incoming projectiles including Geran-5 missiles targeting Kyiv, Lviv, and other major cities. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77260, @mon1tor_ua/77236)
Reactive drones were launched from Vinnytsia region toward Khmelnytskyi region's Khmilnyk area, with additional groups crossing regional boundaries. (Source: @kpszsu/88471, @mon1tor_ua/77266)

Sea-based attack drones were deployed from the Black Sea toward Odessa region, with some projectiles crossing into the northwestern direction toward Odesa-Mikolaiv border area. (Source: @kpszsu/88482, @kpszsu/88469)
Reactive drone groups were detected crossing from Belarus territory toward Volyn region, with one group changing course toward Lutsk. (Source: @kpszsu/88467, @kpszsu/88473)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces continue to escalate attacks on Ukrainian urban centers and critical infrastructure, demonstrating increased operational reach with coordinated multi-vector strikes. The use of Geran-5 cruise missiles and reactive drones across multiple regions indicates enhanced targeting capabilities and sustained offensive capacity. Civilian casualties, particularly among children in Kharkiv region, highlight the deliberate targeting of populated areas. Ukrainian air defenses remain partially effective but are being overwhelmed by the volume and coordination of attacks. The space domain represents a new frontier of concern with Russian aircraft approaching Ukrainian intelligence satellites.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian air defense systems are actively engaging incoming threats across all fronts, with mixed success rates against the coordinated assault. President Zelenskyy has publicly acknowledged the scale of infrastructure damage and civilian casualties, requesting continued Western military support. The destruction of data centers and energy facilities is disrupting essential services for hundreds of thousands of citizens. Ukrainian forces have demonstrated counter-strike capability by hitting Russian radar installations in Bryansk region. International partners are being urged to expedite delivery of additional air defense systems to address capability gaps.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian operational patterns show increased coordination between ground-launched and sea-based drone systems, suggesting improved joint operational planning. The deployment of mesh-networked drones indicates technological advancement in communication and control systems. Satellite reconnaissance activities by Russian aircraft pose emerging threats to Ukrainian space-based intelligence gathering capabilities. Western military aid delays are impacting Ukraine's ability to fully defend against the current wave of attacks. Social media disinformation campaigns are accompanying kinetic operations, with Russian sources claiming disproportionate success.
